- Transfer Macie Harter: .346 BA, 7 HR, 23 RBI at MTSU (2nd Team All-CUSA)
- Fall schedule: opener Sept. 30 at Love's Field (USAO Oct. 23, Seminole State Oct. 30, East Texas A&M Nov. 4)
- 12 returning players + 9 newcomers evaluated
**Source confidence:** HIGH for Wells record (ncaa.com confirmed), HIGH for transfer stats, HIGH for fall schedule

- Jayden Heavener: LHP from LSU, 13-9, 2.81 ERA in 2026 (noted from previous pipeline tracking)
- Head coach Gerry Glasco (Year 2 at TTU, extension through 2030)
- Texas Tech was 2026 WCWS runner-up
- Additional transfers: Moriah Polar (Purdue), Bradi Gallaway (Louisiana Tech), Hailey Maestretti (Utah), Zoie Bernard (Michigan State)
**Source confidence:** HIGH for Beachum stats (texastech.com confirmed), HIGH for Pickering portal ranking, MEDIUM for Heavener full stats (confirmed LHP from LSU, ERA from previous pipeline tracking)
